task.description:
Execute the DSL-03 test suite and produce a structured test report.
1. Run: zig build test (which includes the DSL expression tests)
2. Collect all test results for DSL-03-related tests (expr_error_recovery_test.zig)
3. Write the report to tests/reports/report-<ISO8601>-WF02-dsl03-step04.json

Report format per test_developer_guide.md §8:
- Test ID, description, PASS/FAIL, duration_ms, assertion_count
- Summary: total, passed, failed, skipped
- If any test FAILS: list full error output and stack trace
